name: touchstone-monorepo

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.health: curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/status/health | node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');const d=JSON.parse(s);console.log(d.healthy?'✅ Healthy':'❌ Unhealthy');"

description: Touchstones — verified real-work screening for engineering hiring. Real work. Real person. Provable. A short, AI-allowed work sample scored in code from a rubric, tied to server-attributed proof-of-human, returning one explainable, audit-ready score.
